To be clear:

Sometime everyone that reads this will experience the death of their body. Awake. Asleep. Due to Injury. Due to Disease. Someday. Today. Tomorrow. Next Year. In 15 years. Perhaps in 33 years. Perhaps 66 years from this moment you will go through this experience.

Whatever your final experiences are, whenever they are, they will be as real and as right now, as now is right now.

You lose everything you have learned, everything you remember, all pain, all pleasures, until Nothing.

Your eyes open and you let out a cry. You have been born, passing from your mother's body into the exact time and the exact place you have always been born, and always will be born.

You will go through every struggle, every experience, every pain - physical, mental, spiritual. You will make the same decisions you have made, and you will make in the future, exactly as you do every time.

This is your cage. You always think it is the first time you made love, but you had that experience more than a billion-billion-billion times, in fact that is an infinitesimal fraction of the times you have experienced those moments, and you will experience them forever, each time making the same choices.

You always think it is the first time and only time you live to feel the shock and sorrow of your first parent to die, of the first time a partner dies, the first times you are hurt, or if you get sick and frail and old - you will do that again over and over.

Your life will repeat, and because of your genetics, your experiences, your brain wiring, every decision you make you will make exactly the same. You have no idea you have done this before, and you cannot know the outcome of your decisions.

If you read this, it is because you always do. If you try to radically change your life because what this post says is true - that is what you always do. You always ponder this possibility, that you may be in a maze, a cage, and you always take the same route until your body breaks and you start back at the beginning.

Now that you know the Truth...

Is this Heaven?

Is it Hell?

Is it Possible? If the infinite exists does it mean this has to be true because everything happens, then happens again, if the infinite exists?

Are you happy, sad, is it better to be indifferent because you cannot change it?

Or is this the ultimate motivation to live the best, most fulfilling, happiest version of yourself, at every moment?

Does this idea improve, or destroy? How else can you "be" but this way? Nothing else is you, but this unique shifting complex universe, you depend on every atom in every galaxy being in their place, and they depend on you - or it would not be you.
Your life is an Infinite Loop! Wherever you are in your life today, the Truth is that when you die, you instantly transfer into your infant body when it leaves your mother in that time/place again.
